label: Seznam Sklik
terms_note: Any Sklik advertiser generates an API key in the account (client.loginByToken); endpoints https://api.sklik.cz/drak/RPC2/v5 and /drak/json/v5; Fénix REST at api.sklik.cz/fenix; changelog published. Rate limits: not on the intro page. Free.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (API Drak v5 XML-RPC/JSON + API Fénix REST) Confidence: **high** — official docs read.
auth: 1. Create an API key in the Sklik account (Nastavení → API).
2. `client.loginByToken(token)` → session id; pass `{session}` in every call (session expires; call `client.logout` when done).
3. JSON API: `POST https://api.sklik.cz/drak/json/v5/{method}` with JSON params (datetime as ISO strings, binary as base64).

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Sklik API Fénix refresh token (log in at https://www.sklik.cz/ > Tools > API > create token; you choose its validity and access level r / rw). Exchanged at POST https://api.sklik.cz/v1/user/token (grant_type=refresh_token, form) for a 1-hour access token, re-requested on expiry or 401; the token acts on the refresh token owner's own Sklik account.

me.note: GET /v1/user/me: {userId, userName, actor, scope} of the account the token acts on (API Fénix; spec https://api.sklik.cz/v1/openapi.json).

list_accounts.note: GET /v1/user/linked-accounts: own and managed accounts the token can access (id, username, access r|rw|rwa, agencyStatus, relationStatus). The other tools act on the refresh token owner's account; reaching a managed account needs a token issued with its user_id, which is not configured here. Currency is CZK.

list_campaigns.note: GET /v1/sklik/campaigns/?a=id&a=name&a=status&…&isDeleted=false&status=&limit&offset (API Fénix 'List campaigns'). status is active or suspend. `budget` is budget.dayBudget in HELLERS (100 hellers = 1 CZK). `account_id` is not sent (the token selects the account).

get_report.note: GET /v1/sklik/campaigns/ with statistic attributes (impressions, clicks, ctr, avgCpc, totalMoney, conversions), statisticsDateFrom/To and statisticsGranularity=daily: one row per campaign and day (firstDate). Daily granularity allows at most one month per call. Money is in HELLERS: spend_hellers = totalMoney (clicks + impressions, 100 hellers = 1 CZK). With campaign_id only that campaign is returned. Up to 1000 rows per call.

update_budget.note: PATCH /v1/sklik/campaigns/{campaign_id}/ {budget: {dayBudget}} answers 204. daily_budget is an INTEGER IN HELLERS (100 hellers = 1 CZK; e.g. 50000 = 500 CZK) and fractional values are refused. It changes the campaign's daily budget, which is its own budget object (shared budgets are managed separately). This spends money. `currency` is ignored (CZK).

pause_resume.note: PATCH /v1/sklik/campaigns/{campaign_id}/ {status: suspend|active} (pause → suspend, resume → active); answers 204. Resuming restarts spend. Needs a refresh token with write (rw) access.
